Messages.Author: ANVIL
Messages.Body:
Has anybody tried playing 'FAME' and 'BLOOD DOLL' on Smudge-The Ignored?

Think about it... I know it doesn't count as a successful bleed, /but/...
It seems to be pretty damn effective.

1) Get Smudge into play (Hey shuddup! I like Smudge), or any tiny Vamp.

2) "Make 'em Famous" - (A la Billy the Kid).

3) Play 'BLOOD DOLL' on the poor sap.

4) Yank a blood off (A la 'BLOOD DOLL')
(Prey loses 3 pool)

5) Save Smudge (or whoever) in your minion phase
(Thus preventing your loss of pool in your untap phase if Smudge is in
Topor.)
6) Repeat steps 4 & 5

STUFF TO WATCHOUT FOR!!! --> You MUST make sure Smudge (whoever) is safe in
Torpor! If he gets 'Diab-ed' that screws up this whole plan (unless you got
more than 1 fame in your deck). This means you should usually (heck always)
save Smudge on YOUR minion phase.

And YES there are some small holes in this plan... MINOR BOON, VULNERABILITY,
and some others... Bla bla bla...

I still like it!

Oooh! One more thing! - Watch out for Amaranth if Smudge get rushed!

Another cool trick! ( I'm sure most of you know this one )

Give the 'Muddled Vampire Hunter' the 'Ivory Bow'
Sneaky huh?

-Love and kisses
Anvil - Clan Brujah

P.S. Watch out for those Renagade Garou!

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Everett Littles <elit...@cymbal.aix.calpoly.edu> writes:
>> 4) Yank a blood off (A la 'BLOOD DOLL')
>> (Prey loses 3 pool)

>ahh, no. your prey only losses 3 pool if the vamp goes into torpor.
>Taking one off of Smudge does not make him go into torpor. he just has
>to hunt next turn.

>No hard feelings guy. I did not mean this to be as harsh as it may have

>sounded.
>But hey on the positive side, I might be totally wrong. Scott. Tom.
>Anyone. You want to confirm this? Thanks

Confirmed. Removing a blood (or causing a blood to be burned) won't
send a vampire, even an empty one, to torpor. And Fame only triggers
on the vampire going to torpor. The only things that will send a
vampire to torpor are:

1) Damage that a vampire cannot heal (either from lack of blood or
because the damage was aggravated).
2) Card effects (Day Op., Nos. Performance Art, Rotschreck, Pulled
Fangs) that explicitly place or send a vampire to torpor.

Generic (non-damage) 'burn/steal/remove blood' effects are ignored
by empty vampires.

> 3) Play 'BLOOD DOLL' on the poor sap.

> 4) Yank a blood off (A la 'BLOOD DOLL')
> (Prey loses 3 pool)

Here is the problem in this cycle: you can't take a blood off and send them to
Torpor like this. If you take Smudge to 0 blood with the blood doll, you can't
take any more blood off him to send him to Torpor. Remember, to send him to
Torpor, he will have to take more damage than he has blood - taking a vampire to
0 exactly does not put them in torpor. When Smudge is at 0, ALL HE CAN DO IS
HUNT, unless you then use the Blood doll to give him a blood; which kind of
defeats the whole purpose.

Nuther problem. Taking a blood off via a blood doll isn't even considered damage and cannot send
a vampire to torpor.

So, even if you have 2 blood dolls stacked and attempt to take 2 blood off, Smudge don't go to
Torpor. He only loses 1 blood and then has to hunt during the minion phase.
